what: The brief asked for three suggestion lints that already exist under other names (with the machine-applicable fix); building them again would have been two lints for one concept.
cost: a reading pass to find them; the new `blaze::suggest` group lists the existing ones instead
cause: a lint is found by its name, and the names of one concept differ (`unmarked_*` vs `could_be_*`); nothing maps a concept to its lint
class: duplicate work from a concept known by two names
prevention: a lane brief names lints by what they find, and the lane greps docs/lints.md for the finding's shape before writing one; or one renamed alias (`blaze::RENAMED`) so either name finds it
workaround: grep docs/lints.md for the attribute a lint would suggest before writing it
